error.engine_busy: The switcher is still processing the previous transition command. Try again in a moment.
error.memory_busy: The switcher is still processing a user memory operation. Try again when it finishes.
error.undocumented_command: Remote menu keys use a command that is not in the SE-650 protocol document, so they are off by default. Enable them under Extras if you accept the risk.
error.analog_needs_input: In Analog audio mode only inputs 1-4 can be used (not Follow video).
error.boot_slot: User memory 0 is loaded every time the switcher boots. Confirm before overwriting it.
error.no_state: The switcher's state has not been received yet, so it can't be confirmed Ready. Wait a moment or press Refresh.

log.memory_not_found: User memory {slot} {operation}: nothing saved in that slot
log.not_confirmed: The switcher has not confirmed the last {gate} command. Further {gate} commands are blocked; press Refresh to check again.
log.input_name_timeout: No reply for input {number} name - remaining name requests stopped
